prompts: The match server of our game hangs under load, and the final scores come out low. The score board is the crate in {WS}. Find out why and fix it. Its public API stays as it is, the tests in {WS}/tests stay as they are, and the crate takes no new dependencies.
answers:
[goal]
Fix hangs and lost scores; preserve public API, existing tests, and dependencies.

[action]
Changed [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs) to protect player scores and total with one shared mutex. Assumed rejoining replaces the previous score. Added regression tests without changing `tests/`.

[result]
Found lost updates from split read/write locks, transfer deadlocks from reversed lock order, and self-transfer deadlocks. Rejoining also inflated totals.

Before fixing, regressions reproduced a timeout and totals of `39983` instead of `40000`. After fixing, `cargo test` reported:

```text
test result: ok. 3 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 0.06s
test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 0.00s
```

`cargo fmt --check` also passed. Atomic operations eliminate lost updates; a single lock eliminates transfer lock cycles.

[next]
Ready for review.
